newsitem.title: INDIA: India BHEL ties up with Siemens.
newsitem.headline: India BHEL ties up with Siemens.

text.p: India's state-run Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd (BHEL) and Siemens AG of Germany have set up a joint venture to revamp fossil fuel power plants, a BHEL statement said on Thursday.

"BHEL has joined hands with multinational corporation Siemens AG, Germany to set up a 50:50 owned joint venture company in India for carrying out plant performance improvement (PPI) of old fossil fuel power plants," the statement said.
The joint venture would focus on the domestic market and in other mutually agreed countries.
Nearly 54,000 MW of India's installed capacity is thermal. A large number of the power plants are old or due for revamping.
The PPI process restores or upgrades old fossil power plants and increases generation.
"The proposed joint venture would further strengthen the close cooperation existing between the two companies for more than two decades in the power equipment field," the statement said.
